item.title: Zevra Miplyffa Launch
item.description:
• Summary: Zevra Therapeutics is launching Miplyffa (arimoclomol) for Niemann-Pick disease type C, a rare neurodegenerative disorder. The CEO aims to foster a European-style market access model in the US to ensure patient access to the expensive therapy.
  • MoAs: Heat shock protein co-inducer; enhances protein folding and reduces cellular stress
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma
